title: Monsters Level Up
note: milestones: iron armor, diamond armor, enchanting, Nether, Ender Dragon; gear, shields, reinforcements, behaviors

title: Mod Scaling
note: gear and effects by progress (iron, diamond, totem, Nether, stronghold, dragon); no stat scaling

title: Advanced Mobs
note: elite versions of zombies, skeletons, blazes that scale with the vanilla difficulty setting

title: D2 Affix
note: Diablo 2 style elite tiers, affixes and auras; data driven JSON under config/d2affix/elite_types

title: Summoners
note: 5 % of hostile mobs become Summoners that call reinforcements; jar not downloaded

title: In Control!
note: rule files under config/incontrol (spawn, summonaid, phases, effects, events); slug is in-control (earlier note used incontrol)

title: Mob Dice Attributes
note: random attribute rolls whose average equals vanilla; not a buff

title: MobSpawnController
note: spawn toggles, conditions, multipliers, attributes and equipment presets by command or GUI

title: Alex's Mobs
note: 89 mobs, mostly real-world creatures; boss mobs exist; not a difficulty mod
